exposure: operative vaginal delivery with forceps or vacuum
cohort: Healthy nulliparous women with spontaneous labor onset and term, singleton, vertex fetus
finding: In low-risk nulliparous laboring women, care by obstetricians compared with nurse-midwives was associated with increased risk of labor interventions and operative birth.
mod_finding: Care by obstetricians compared to nurse-midwives was associated with an increased risk of unplanned cesarean birth in low-risk nulliparous women.
